objective: Collect genuinely forward immutable USDT plus USDC supply evidence for the unchanged 30-observation expansion rule that was undersampled in Protocol v11.

candidate.signal_rule: buy iff aggregate USDT plus USDC SplyCur is strictly greater than thirty daily observations earlier; flat otherwise; emit only on state change

collection.end_time_rule: collection UTC date minus two calendar days
collection.bootstrap_before_forward_start: state seed only; never counts as forward evidence
collection.historical_revision_policy: fail closed and require human review
collection.missing_policy: no forward fill and no synthetic stablecoin or BTC row

evidence_gate.review_scope: data quality and whether to continue collection only
qualified_observation_requires: raw Coin Metrics response preserved and hashed
both USDT and USDC present on the target UTC day
complete daily asset grid from the fixed bootstrap start
target observation consumed only at D+2
official BTC closed hourly overlap contiguous
